Definition: a Zamzumite, or native tribe of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Zamzummim is named once, in Deuteronomy 2:20. In Deuteronomy 2:20 we read, "(That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;".
TheologicalSignificance: Zamzummim is one of the names that makes the Bible feel like a real history to me.
